premises.text: Post-production for reality TV is time-consuming due to inefficient communication and project management.
premises.evidence_span: one minute of the final product takes up to 17 hours of post-production

premises.text: First Cut Pro is a communication and project management tool designed for video professionals.
premises.evidence_span: First Cut Pro is a communication and project management tool for video professionals

premises.text: First Cut Pro allows users to create viewing rooms for streamlined feedback on video content.
premises.evidence_span: all Paul needs to do is drop in a link, and he creates a viewing room

premises.text: Timestamped feedback can be collected and made actionable within the platform.
premises.evidence_span: we've made it really easy by allowing users to set their own kind of quick comments

premises.text: First Cut Pro integrates with popular video editing software for seamless workflow.
premises.evidence_span: Tony to then export it directly into his favorite video editing software

premises.text: First Cut Pro is browser-based and leverages existing hosting infrastructure, making it easy for IT departments.
premises.evidence_span: it's browser-based and we leverage using existing hosting infrastructure

premises.text: There is a network effect among different companies using First Cut Pro.
premises.evidence_span: there's a network effect amongst different companies

premises.text: First Cut Pro can accommodate teams of all sizes and types of video content.
premises.evidence_span: teams that no matter how big or small they are, nor the type of content being created

value.text: First Cut Pro enhances collaboration and efficiency in video post-production.
value.evidence_span: we keep on bringing post-production out of the Stone Age
